title: Simulated Engineering Environment - Entity Schemas
description: Schemas for every entity the Simulation Connector exposes. Derived directly from the generated data by scripts/build_schemas.py, so it cannot drift from what the connector returns. `x-references` marks foreign key fields.
x-data-classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

Component.description: Components with supplier allocation and revision level.

CorrectiveAction.description: Containment, corrective and preventive actions with effectiveness verification.

EngineeringChange.description: Engineering change requests across the programmes.

Evidence.description: Evidence records derived from test results, documents and measurements.

FailureMode.description: Design and process failure modes with S/O/D ratings.

Measurement.description: Simulated measurement series with synthetic values.

Programme.description: Vehicle programmes in the simulated environment.

QualityIssue.description: Quality issues from field, plant, supplier and test origins.

Requirement.description: Requirements at vehicle, system, subsystem, component and process level.

Risk.description: Risk register derived from failure modes with H or M action priority.

RootCause.description: Root causes with five-why chains and confirmation state.

Signal.description: Vehicle signal catalogue for telemetry and diagnostics.

Standard.description: Standards and regulations. Identifier, title, body and scope tag only.

TestResult.description: Test results including pass, fail, inconclusive and not_run states.

TestCase.description: Test cases with acceptance criteria and traceability.
